source_retrieval: Versioned primary arXiv HTML downloaded via urllib; bytes hashed, full papers not redistributed. Unversioned abs pages checked for latest version. HTML rendering hashes may change without a new manuscript version.

papers.title: Efficient and high-performance routing of lattice-surgery paths on three-dimensional lattice
papers.overlap: Instruction-ready lookahead and 3D Dijkstra projection already exist.
papers.unconfirmed: Original algorithm not reproduced on a common backend; bounded two-front rollout is not that algorithm.

papers.title: O3LS: Optimizing Lattice Surgery via Automatic Layout Searching and Loose Scheduling
papers.overlap: Layout/rotation/routing-time and layer-wise logical-error trade-offs already exist.
papers.unconfirmed: No original O3LS implementation run; do not label our proxy as original O3LS.

papers.title: SPARO: Surface-code Pauli-based Architectural Resource Optimization for Fault-tolerant Quantum Computing
papers.overlap: Primitive-calibrated PPM/idle/rotation layer recurrence and same-area resource allocation already exist.
papers.unconfirmed: Paper says software will be open sourced; artifact URL not verified in reviewed source or searches. This does not prove no artifact exists.

papers.title: Synchronization for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers
papers.overlap: Placement of synchronization slack and additional syndrome rounds already affect logical reliability.
papers.unconfirmed: No faithful Active/Hybrid implementation in our backend; different noise and time policy require separate controls.

papers.title: Demand-Driven Routing Space for Lattice-Surgery Compilation
papers.overlap: Fixed chip volume, stage movement, lane budgets and criticality/resource-aware frontier routing already exist.
papers.unconfirmed: MiniFlash artifact linked by paper but not inspected or reproduced this run; dynamic geometry outside our validated domain.

papers.title: Patchwork: automated lattice surgery and space-time partitioning for real-time decoding
papers.overlap: Observable orientation already guides physical gate scheduling via cut lines; observable generation and partitioned decoding already exist.
papers.unconfirmed: Paper describes upcoming software; no verified artifact URL. Application-level protected-idle ranking is not demonstrated equivalent or novel by this review.

papers.title: AlphaSyndrome: Tackling the Syndrome Measurement Circuit Scheduling Problem for QEC Codes
papers.overlap: Decoder-in-loop MCTS, fault propagation, logical support and simulated multi-observable failure already guide syndrome scheduling.
papers.unconfirmed: Paper overall X/Z formula and artifact per-partition reward are distinct; no common-budget reproduction; no novelty claim from application-level change alone.

papers.title: Do Not Let CNOTs Overwhelm the Decoder: Scheduling Transversal Gates for Fast FTQC
papers.overlap: PACE searches bounded TCNOT spacing policies under DEM latency, memory and decode capacity constraints.
papers.unconfirmed: TCNOT architecture and decoder-capacity objective differ from lattice-surgery output-error ranking; no direct performance comparison.
